text:
marta: Heads-up — onboarding Skyline's adapter (v1.2) onto redwood-7b. Merge + 4-bit quant done, but multi-turn instruction responses degrade: repetition and context loss after ~30 tokens. Quick eval pack attached. Anyone seen this pattern after adapter merges? :eyes:

kai: Hmm — did you merge weights with the exact base config (n_ctx, rotary dims, kv-cache layout)?

marta: I used our standard merge script:
```bash
python merge_lora.py --base redwood-7b --adapter skyline-v1.2 --out skyline-7b-merged 
python quantize.py --model skyline-7b-merged --bits 4 --out skyline-7b-4bit
```
No custom config edits.

raj: Can you paste the model config diffs? My guess is KV cache ordering or rotary scale mismatch after merge + quant. Those cause truncation/repeat loops.

marta: Pasting diff (small):
```diff
- n_ctx: 2048
+ n_ctx: 2048
- rotary_dim: 64
+ rotary_dim: 32  # ???
```
Not sure how that changed — adapter's metadata had rotary_dim: 32. Should we force a rewrite to 64?

jena: If adapter metadata differs, we either remap rotary params during merge or reject the adapter. For quick unblock, try remapping rotary -> full dims or rebuild merge with --ignore-adapter-meta.

sam: Also check that the KV cache dtype/layout matches quantizer expectations. 4-bit kernels assume packed KV layout. If adapter was trained with different caching, you get off-by-one in indexing and the model reads wrong past tokens.

marta: Re-ran merge with --ignore-adapter-meta and explicit rotary_dim=64, then re-quantized. Eval bot results below.

eval-bot: Quick-eval summary for skyline-7b-4bit-fixed (small eval pack, 120 prompts):
- instr-following exact match: 78% -> up from 54%
- repetition rate (token-level): 11% -> down from 36%
- avg latency: 86ms per token (hot cache)
- regression tests: hallucination examples reduced from 6 -> 1

marta: Nice, looks better. Will run full pack overnight. One remaining oddity: a few prompts still emit an early "I don't have information" fallback mid-answer. Possibly adapter learned a fallback token distribution.

raj: Add a small targeted eval with the customer's instruction examples. If we still see fallback, we can try a lightweight reweighting of adapter peaks (alpha tuning) before final merge.

jena: Add to checklist for onboarding: 1) verify adapter meta vs base (rotary, n_ctx) 2) try ignore-adapter-meta merge if mismatch 3) validate KV layout pre-quant 4) run tiny targeted evals 5) alpha-sweep if fallback. I'll update the onboarding doc. :memo:

marta: Thanks all. I'll post full overnight results in the morning and include a diff patch for the merge script that logs adapter vs base meta automatically. :thumbsup:

kai: Great. If overnight shows clean results, we can add an automated step in CI to reject adapters with persistent meta mismatch.

sam: Onboarding note: instrument prefix-cache sanity check in runtime — failing that check should trigger fallback to 8-bit path instead of serving a bad 4-bit model.

marta: Filing follow-ups: #1 tweak merge script, #2 CI gate, #3 runtime sanity check. Will ping owners. :party_parrot:
